主要内容: Visteon Corporation (NYSE: VC) will present its latest automotive cockpit electronics products and innovations at the 2014 International CES, including new concepts offering advanced connected car features and Cloud-based technology for upcoming vehicle platforms. The HMeye cockpit concept features a unique user interface controlled by eye gaze and head direction data, with selection controls retained on the steering wheel to improve response time. The OASIS concept protects the vehicle communication network by providing a secure method to connect the vehicle to the user and Cloud computing. Visteon also unveiled two new automotive brands and collaborated with Renault on a connected cockpit electronics solution. Timothy D. Leuliette, Visteon president and CEO, emphasized the company's role in developing solutions for the converging worlds of consumer electronics and automotive technology. Marty Thall, president, Visteon Electronics, highlighted the importance of strategic collaborations in bringing innovative products to market quickly. Visteon's presence at CES extends beyond its exhibit, with Tim Yerdon participating in a panel discussion on the future of driving technology.
